Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
>
> fast reaction says: Tap this vampire.
> does this mean i cannot play this with the help of wake with evening's
> freshness or forced awakening because those won't allow the vampire to
> untap?

No. Tapping a tapped vampire has no effect. Being untapped is not a
requirement of the card (except inasfar as it is a reaction card,
and that requirement is lifted by Wakey).
